record.question: Which statement is not correct regarding 'Gram Sabha'?
options: It is a village assembly consisting of all the registered voters in the area of the Panchayat.
Its powers and functions at village level are like state legislature at the state level.
It is a body consisting of persons registered in the electoral rolls of a village comprised within the area of the Panchayat level.
Its powers have been provided in the 12th Schedule.
